target_pattern: Use present subjunctive after key triggers like querer que, cuando for pending future actions, and antes de que; simplify to antes de + infinitive when the subject does not change.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Trying to translate clause by clause with indicative forms and skipping the trigger logic.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Subjunctive is a pattern response: once the trigger appears, the next clause takes subjunctive if there is a subject change.
target_pattern_formula: build subjunctive from yo form base
natural_examples: Te llamo antes de que salgas.
Siempre cierro todo antes de acostarme.
Necesitamos que el equipo responda hoy.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as directed.
drills: Base: Quiero que vayas a la tienda. -> change subject receiver to nosotros.
Base: Quiero que Juan llegue temprano. -> change person to Maria and verb to llamar.
Base: Avisame cuando llegues a casa. -> change verb to tener and object to la informacion.
Base: Te llamo antes de que salgas. -> change subject to ella.
Base: Mi jefe quiere que termine hoy. -> change to plural subject nosotros.
Base: Necesito que me ayudes. -> make it negative.
Base: Prefiero que hables con Ana. -> change to ustedes.
Base: Es importante que lleguemos a tiempo. -> change to singular yo.
Base: Me alegra que estes aqui. -> change to plural ustedes.
Base: Me lavo los dientes antes de acostarme. -> change action to salir.
Base: Maria me llamo antes de acostarse. -> change infinitive action to irse.
Base: Te aviso cuando reciba tu mensaje. -> change recipient to ustedes.
Base: Quieres que te traiga tu chaqueta? -> change object to un cafe.
Base: Siempre cierro la puerta antes de salir. -> change verb cerrar to apagar las luces.
Base: Espero que podamos hablar hoy. -> change verb poder to tener.

contrastive_discrimination.instructions: Choose the option that sounds natural in Spanish.
prompts: I want you to come. (Quiero que vienes. vs Quiero que vengas.)
Let me know when you arrive home. (Avisame cuando llegas a casa. vs Avisame cuando llegues a casa.)
I call you before you leave. (Te llamo antes de que sales. vs Te llamo antes de que salgas.)
I brush my teeth before going to bed. (Me cepillo los dientes antes de que me acuesto. vs Me cepillo los dientes antes de acostarme.)
My son leaves before I wake up. (Mi hijo sale antes de que me despierte. vs Mi hijo sale antes de despertarme.)
I need you to explain this. (Necesito que explicas esto. vs Necesito que expliques esto.)
It is important that we arrive early. (Es importante que llegamos temprano. vs Es importante que lleguemos temprano.)
I am happy you are here. (Me alegra que estas aqui. vs Me alegra que estes aqui.)
Do you want me to bring your jacket? (Quieres que te traigo tu chaqueta? vs Quieres que te traiga tu chaqueta?)
Tell me when you want to go. (Dime cuando quieres ir. vs Dime cuando quieras ir.)

common_errors.why_it_happens: Indicative is reused after a subjunctive trigger.
Future-pending action is treated as present fact.
Que-clause is mixed with infinitive structure.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Antes de salir (same subject) / antes de que salgas (different subject).

common_errors.mistake: Te llamo antes de que sales
common_errors.why_it_happens: Subjunctive is not activated after antes de que.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Te llamo antes de que salgas.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Present indicative ending is used by default.
Impersonal trigger is followed by indicative.
Emotion trigger does not trigger subjunctive in learner model.

common_errors.mistake: Quieres que te traigo tu chaqueta?
common_errors.why_it_happens: Querer que clause keeps indicative verb.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Quieres que te traiga tu chaqueta?

common_errors.mistake: Maria me llamo antes de que acostarse
common_errors.correct_spanish: Maria me llamo antes de que me acostara (past) / antes de acostarse (same subject).

common_errors.mistake: Dime cuando quieres ir (for unknown future timing)
common_errors.why_it_happens: Known habitual meaning and pending action meaning are mixed.
